definition: A model reproducing training examples verbatim rather than abstracting from them.
details: A model reproducing training examples verbatim rather than abstracting from them. A privacy and copyright concern (extraction attacks) and a quality concern (benchmark contamination); deduplication reduces it.

explainer.lead: A model reproducing training examples verbatim rather than abstracting from them. It is a privacy and copyright concern (extraction attacks) and a quality concern (benchmark contamination); deduplication reduces it.

tiers.eli5: Instead of learning the lesson, the model parrots back whole pages it saw during training.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers watch for verbatim reproduction of training data, which raises privacy and copyright issues via extraction attacks, and use deduplication to reduce it.
tiers.paperLevel: A model reproducing training examples verbatim rather than abstracting from them; a privacy and copyright concern (extraction attacks) and a quality concern (benchmark contamination), reduced by deduplication.

explainer.example: Prompted in a certain way, a model emits a passage from its training data word for word.
